title: LENTICULAR
description: A full-width claim in Bricolage Grotesque ('Gentrit Rashiti builds web and phone apps for learners, care teams and shoppers.') and a role line sit over a wide lenticular print of Bayyinah TV on a bone ground: bayyinahtv.com cropped above the site's own marketing band, with a thin band of App Store strips at its right edge. Once after load the print turns to its App Store face and back; beside it, the two face labels (bayyinahtv.com ⇄ App Store), the fact that the same web app runs on the site and in both store apps, role and years, and three public links.
signature: Type: Bricolage Grotesque 640 (opsz auto) for the claim at 66px (34px on a phone, four lines), Public Sans for text, Gentrit Technical Mono 13px for years and the 16 → 2 line. Colour: bone ground #f7efea; ink #1f1518 sampled from bayyinahtv.com's ground; one accent #b41d02 sampled from its Start Learning button, job: the face a print shows, focus and link hover; the prints carry all other colour; About sits on the ink. Motion: the tilt, a print turned 9° on its vertical axis by a spring (visualDuration 0.5 s, bounce 0.12); the switch sweeps across 4px lenses from the edge that turns away. Flick or drag hands the hand's velocity to spring.snap; the face labels are a radio group (pointer: spring, keyboard: instant). The hero peeks once after load (0° → 9° → 0° in 760 ms) and is skipped under reduced motion or after a touch. At rest every card is drawn as seen from a little to its left, so its right edge shows a thin band of the second screen's strips: the material reads in a still.
rule: The page is a stack of lenticular prints: each picture holds two real screens of one product, and the angle of the card picks which one you see.
designRead: Reading this as: a frontend and mobile developer for hiring managers and recruiters, leading with Bayyinah TV (one web app that runs on the website and inside both store apps), in a world of lenticular prints where every picture holds two real screens of one product.
hook: The site where every screenshot is a lenticular card: turn the Bayyinah TV one and bayyinahtv.com becomes the App Store page, with the same headline on both.
lead: Bayyinah TV: public and checkable (website, App Store, Google Play), 2023–26, frontend in the core team, and its key fact — the same web app runs on the site and inside both store apps — is exactly a two-face fact for a two-image print.
composition: first-screen.md #3, the claim drawn as a picture: one object holds the web page and the app listing. Claim full width on top; the print large on the left (8 of 12 columns); the project's facts, face labels and links in a narrow right column. Below: a reading block, then rows that alternate print-left / two narrow phone prints / print-right on alternating grounds, a dense index, and About on the ink.

Based in Kosovo, working remotely.', bayyinahtv.com as a real screen at 37% of the first screen (no marketing numbers in view), Frontend core team 2023–26, links to the website, App Store and Google Play
fourAnswers.phone: who: Gentrit Rashiti / what: web and phone apps (claim in four lines) / for whom: learners, care teams and shoppers / proof: the role and location line, the print at y ≈ 280–565 (both faces cropped to the same 'Quran Studies Made Simple' headline), Frontend core team 2023–26, Website, App Store and Google Play links at the bottom edge of 844

allowed: C17: dev-server LCP (1.3–1.7 s at 4×) is the draft router's two lazy levels; a production build at 4× paints at 0.68–0.82 s with CLS 0 and 0 warnings; this page's own code is 9.6 kB gzip

holdback: Original, 7: the material is real and tied to 'web and phone', but it sits on a familiar skeleton (claim over a screen, facts in a side column, rows, an index, a dark footer), and at rest a still capture shows a screenshot with faint ribs; the lenticular only reads once the card turns.
skillNotes: Helped: (1) M3's test, 'explain the effect in one sentence of engineering', pushed me past a striped CSS overlay to a computed lens: interlaced strips, a 2× cylindrical lens per 4px, the angle from the eye to each lens (tilt plus the lens's offset) picks the strip, so the flip sweeps across the card; and the lamp's glints are a specular term per lens. (2) motion.md's build order (static end state, cause, one token, interruptible, reduced branch, measure, scrub) mapped one-to-one, and the frequency gate settled that keyboard activation jumps. (3) first-screen.md's phone rules (work above 500px, text ≥ 11px in the crop) led to separate phone crops where both faces show the same headline. (4) The checker caught real things: words past the fold (C02), phone targets, a hidden canvas below the fold (M08), the word 'codebase' (T10f). Unclear or wrong: (a) There is no way to capture an interaction-triggered signature moment mid-flight: --frames times from navigation, element screenshots wait for a stable box so they never catch a rotation, and Playwright's fake clock did not drive motion's springs in real proportion. I scrubbed by dragging to fixed angles; the skill should ship '--interact <selector> --frames-after 60,150,300' or document clip screenshots at fixed states. (b) M08 counts an opacity-0 overlay canvas as a 'section that starts invisible' even though the picture under it is visible; a lazily built overlay is not a fade-up. (c) C17 on the required dev server is dominated by the host app's lazy router (two Suspense levels) and the unbundled module graph: 1.6 s dev vs 0.82 s production at 4×; the brief asks for dev + throttle, so every draft will warn; suggest measuring against a production preview or reporting time from the draft's own first paint. (d) Hard rule 9 allows 'one authored figure may build once' while first-screen.md lists 'loader, intro' as costing credibility; it is unclear whether a settle-on-load of the hero work (readable from the first frame) counts as the authored figure or as an intro. I read it as allowed and gated it (reduced motion, late lens, prior touch). (e) 'The claim sets in 2–4 lines at 32–40px' collides with a 15-word claim in a wide grotesque at 358px (5 lines at 34px); say which gives way: words, size or face. (f) The rule 'original or hook ≤ 7 → go back to direct' conflicts with a fixed round of at most two polish passes; there is no step for a re-direct. (g) The checker changed format mid-round (T23 now needs 4+ matches; --list and checks.md appeared later). (h) The tintedGround signal reads body's background; a draft inside a shared shell must restyle body at runtime to get credit. Missing: Crafted-band guidance that the material must read in a still capture (reviewers judge captures first), and a note that a static fallback should match the canvas's rest frame pixel for pixel so the swap does not pop. Polish pass: the new snippets/mechanism.md spec (capture after 5px, velocity hand-off, radio group, still-capture line) mapped directly onto the reviewer's findings, and --interact made the mid-flight capture possible without my own scripts. The radio pattern collides with the checker's focus test (C11 reads the focused element's own outline, so a visually hidden input would warn); covering the label with an appearance:none input that draws the ring solves both and could be in the snippet. A flaky C12 on the dev server can come from other builders' edits regenerating the shared Tailwind CSS via HMR; the checker could ignore shifts that coincide with a stylesheet swap, or say to confirm C12 on a production build.
polish: Fact (owner 3): the hero's bayyinahtv.com face is cropped above the site's marketing band at both widths (no '500k learners / +20y / 2000h' or testimonials in the first screen); the print is now 2880×1350 wide with four App Store frames as the second face, and a comment in the data records why.
Fact (owner 1): Design System v2 index line kept exactly as the owner rewrote it; the index is now grouped by employer and Vianova appears only on its own group.
Fact (owner 2): care row now says each screen moves over only when its test passes on both apps 'and none is live yet'; nothing says care teams use new screens.

Fact: Bayyinah authorship now 'A core frontend team, Gentrit among them, rebuilt the second version from an empty project.'; Offday result now 'About 200 tests, including checks that each team sees only its own data.'; 'programme' → 'program'; 'codebase' already removed.

Clarity/phone: role and location line under the claim at every width ('Frontend and mobile developer since 2021, now full stack. Based in Kosovo, working remotely.'); claim shortened to 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and phone apps for learners, care teams and shoppers.' (four lines at 390).

Clarity: index links (internal and external) are underlined at rest with a → or ↗, and the index is grouped (Vianova, Public products, Incentiv, AvahiTech, Own products) with one rule per group; footer note rewritten in plain words (no '4 pixels').

Caption decision: no 'Drag or tap' instruction. The skill's hook-line rule forbids instructions, and the affordance is not invisible: two labelled faces in a radio group (one underlined), a grab cursor, the once-only peek after load, and now the resting edge band all show the card turns. The caption states the fact instead: 'Two real screens in one print: the website and the App Store page.'
Phone prints: Read to Feed and Viva Fresh are cropped to the app screen inside each store frame (phoneScreens.ts boxes), not the store art; Read to Feed pairs My Books ⇄ Achievements ('Badges').

Mechanism (snippets/mechanism.md): the face labels are a native radio group (one Tab stop, arrow keys; keyboard changes are instant, pointer changes spring); drag captures after 5px; release hands the hand's velocity over the last ~100 ms to spring.snap, so a flick turns the card (tested: 60px flick right → 9°, left → 0°); rubber band at both ends; tap toggles; the print is a role=group with an accessible name.

Still capture (the material reads at rest): each card is computed as seen from a little to its left, so its right edge shows a thin band (≤ 120px or 12% of the card) of the second screen's strips; lens seams now show only while the card is turned; the glint stays.

Craft: eye distance 5200 → 8000px and a narrower switch window, so the second face rests at 9° (was 14°) and its small text is barely skewed; the hero no longer starts on the App Store face (the 'dark slab' before images arrive is gone: the card is a light sheet until its picture paints) and instead peeks once from the website and back.
Phone captions stack (labels, then provenance) so nothing rewraps after load.

Not done in this pass (bounded): the reviewer's fix 5 (give the care card a web-and-phone pair) — there is no phone capture of the care platform, so the care pair stays team ⇄ one patient; the reviewer's note that only the hero card is likely to be turned is answered only by the resting edge band on every card.

Checker after the pass (dev, --frames 150,400,900 --throttle 4 --interact click on the App Store label, frames 60/150/300/600): PASS, 0 fails, 0 warnings, C17 allowed. Production preview at 4×: PASS, 0 warnings, CLS 0, LCP 0.68–0.82 s. Two dev runs during the pass showed a transient C12 (0.04–0.13) during the checker's scroll walk; it never appeared on the production build or in my own throttled replays, and the timing matched other builders' edits regenerating the shared Tailwind stylesheet through Vite HMR.
